title: Writer Assistant Core review API implementation and tests-first route boundary

goal: Publish the implementation parent that authorizes a minimal pure backend.review_api helper module to satisfy the expected-red review API contract tests added by PHASE8-IMPL-013-T005, while preserving the boundaries from PHASE8-IMPL-013-T002 (read-only review queue API contract), PHASE8-IMPL-013-T003 (owner action command API contract), and PHASE8-IMPL-013-T004 (review UI planning boundary). PHASE8-IMPL-014-T001 is docs/status/planning only and does not implement backend.review_api, register FastAPI routes in backend/app.py, implement frontend review UI, implement frontend API helpers, implement owner action execution, implement apply-promotion, mutate memory/canon, implement raw artifact persistence, implement runtime extraction, install BookNLP/spaCy, or run BookNLP/spaCy.
why_now: PHASE8-IMPL-013 is complete through T007 and delivered the read-only review queue API contract decision, the owner action command API contract decision, the review UI planning boundary decision, and expected-red review API contract tests at tests/test_writer_assistant_review_api_contract.py for future backend.review_api. PHASE8-IMPL-012-T005 delivered backend/story_knowledge/review_queue_storage.py as a pure, project-local, candidate-linked, candidate-only, review-workflow-only queue storage helper with write/read/list/index plus owner action record shape validation only. PHASE8-IMPL-011-T005 delivered backend/story_knowledge/candidate_review_gate.py as a pure candidate-only/review-pending persistence gate. The expected-red contract tests pin the public API surface (list_review_queue_entries_readonly, get_review_queue_entry_readonly, get_review_queue_index_readonly, get_review_queue_summary_readonly, validate_review_queue_read_request, validate_owner_action_command_request, build_owner_action_command_response). The next risk is accidental backend route registration, owner action execution, frontend review UI scope creep, or apply-promotion while satisfying the contract tests. Before implementing backend.review_api, the app needs a parent that authorizes a minimal pure helper module, splits read-only review queue helpers from owner action command validators, requires fail-closed validation, requires preservation of evidence/provenance/uncertainty, requires no mutation through the read-only surface, requires no owner action execution through the command validator, and preserves the no-route/no-UI/no-promotion/no-memory-canon/no-runtime-extraction/no-generated-prose boundaries.

How should fail-closed validation reject unknown/forbidden fields and unsafe IDs?
How should memory/canon mutation and apply-promotion remain excluded from this parent while remaining MVP-required in later parents?
How should runtime extraction and raw artifact persistence remain excluded from this parent while remaining MVP-required in later parents?
How should generated prose/rewrite/continuation remain permanently forbidden?

context_tools_policy: No CCE, Graphify, Repomix, AI Context, MCP tools, or LeanCTX were authorized or run for T001.
external_tool_policy: No external tools were installed, cloned, fetched, pulled, executed, imported, copied, or vendored in T001.
candidate_record_policy: Candidate records remain candidate-only and review-pending and never become canon, memory, owner decisions, or promotion by default. T001 does not modify candidate schema/record/storage/persistence/list/index modules.
review_queue_policy: Review queue entries are workflow support only, not approval, canon, memory, storyform truth, owner decisions, generated prose, or apply-promotion. T001 does not implement review UI/API, routes, owner action execution, or persistence beyond the inherited PHASE8-IMPL-012 helper.
review_api_policy: backend.review_api is authorized as a pure helper module in later children (T003-T005). FastAPI route registration remains deferred to a later owner-approved parent. Any review queue API must be read-only, review-workflow-only, evidence/provenance-backed, and must never expose approval/canon/promotion or perform apply-promotion. T001 does not implement a review API.
owner_action_api_policy: Owner action command validators and response builders in backend.review_api are authorized as pure helpers in later children (T003/T005). review_ui_policy: Review UI display/interaction boundaries are decided in PHASE8-IMPL-013-T004. Frontend review UI implementation remains deferred to a later owner-approved parent. T001 does not implement review UI.
owner_review_policy: Owner review is mandatory before queue entries or candidate records can become approved truth.
apply_promotion_policy: Apply-promotion remains unimplemented and is not authorized by this parent, but it is MVP-required before usability/testing and must be explicit, audited, owner-confirmed, and never automatic.
memory_canon_policy: No memory/canon mutation is authorized by this parent; approved memory/canon mutation is MVP-required later only through apply-promotion or another explicit owner-approved workflow.
no_runtime_extraction_policy: No real BookNLP/spaCy runtime, extraction tool execution, backend extraction route, frontend extraction UI, or package/dependency change is authorized by this parent; real BookNLP/spaCy and runtime extraction are MVP-required later.
analysis_runtime_policy: NCP/Subtxt/dramatica-flow runtime integration is excluded from this parent but MVP-required later as analysis/context/rubric runtime only, with NCP imports non-authoritative, Subtxt outputs evidence-gated observations or diagnostic questions, and dramatica-flow prose-production paths blocked.
model_assisted_extraction_policy: Model-assisted extraction is excluded from this parent but MVP-required later as evidence-backed candidate drafts or diagnostic questions only; it must never write canon/memory directly and must never apply-promotion automatically.
no_generated_prose_policy: Generated prose, rewrite, continuation, imitation, polish, improvement, and expansion are permanently forbidden and are not planned or deferred features.
